yourPDF · Good to know

Privacy, without the fine-print maze

Updated 20 October 2026.

Your documents

The PDF and image tools in this release process selected documents locally in your browser. Application code does not upload document contents, filenames or previews to a server. Processing libraries are served from this same website. No external font, analytics, ad or session-replay services are included.

Workspace lifetime

Files and results are held in tab memory so you can continue into another tool. Start over, refresh or close the page to clear the workspace. Downloaded files remain on your device. Browser memory, caching and downloaded-file handling are controlled by your browser.

Website requests

The hosting provider receives ordinary page and asset requests, potentially including IP address, browser information and access-control information. Its own policies govern infrastructure logs. This differs from uploading your documents. Application code does not set cookies or persist documents to browser storage.

Hosting

This site is hosted by Netlify. Page and asset requests are handled by its infrastructure. See Netlify’s privacy policy for its processing practices.

Advertising and cookies

Advertising is not active on this release. We do not currently load Google AdSense scripts or set advertising cookies. A verification meta tag, if present, only identifies the publisher account and does not load advertising code.

If Google advertising is enabled later, Google and other third-party advertising vendors may use cookies and similar technologies based on visits to this and other sites. Google and its partners may use those cookies to personalize ads. You can manage Google advertising personalization through My Ad Center and learn how Google uses information from sites that use its services. Other participating vendors offer choices through YourAdChoices.

Before advertising starts, this notice will be updated to describe the active providers and consent choices. No consent banner or advertising consent collection is active today.

Contacting support

If you contact a published support address, the information you choose to send is handled by the email provider and used to respond to your request. Do not send private PDFs or identity documents. The contact page lists available support options.

Future changes

If a later tool needs a server upload or tracking, that behavior must be disclosed before it happens. This release does not offer server processing.
